results.name: World History Timeline Sim

results.fullDescription:
World History Timeline Sim is an interactive world history learning app where you can explore the past, make choices at major historical turning points, and see how alternate timelines could unfold.

Learn from over 2,000 major world history events across ancient civilizations, medieval empires, revolutions, world wars, scientific discoveries, social movements, global trade, cultural milestones, and modern history. The main feature is Time Travel Mode, a realistic alternate history simulator with over 2,000 what-if history scenarios. Step into major events like the fall of Rome, the French Revolution, the Industrial Revolution, World War I, World War II, the Cold War, decolonization, the Space Race, civil rights movements, ancient empire conflicts, and scientific breakthroughs. Choose what you would do, then watch a chain of consequences unfold.

Each time travel scenario includes historical context, what actually happened, realistic decision options, tradeoffs, future impact, and a Butterfly Effect Score. See how one changed event could affect war, diplomacy, science, culture, economy, human rights, technology, and the future of the world.

Features include:

Time Travel Mode
Jump into historical events, make choices, and compare your alternate timeline with real history.

Rewrite History Campaign
Progress through eras like ancient history, medieval history, revolutions, world wars, the Cold War, and modern global history.

Daily Time Jump
Get a new daily history simulation and discover a different event every day.

World History Timeline
Browse major events by year, era, region, country, and category.

World History Map
Explore where major wars, empires, inventions, revolutions, landmarks, and civilizations happened.

Civilization Survival Mode
Manage famous civilizations through real historical pressures like food shortages, invasion risk, trade collapse, disease, political instability, climate stress, and diplomacy.

Timeline Detective
Solve historical mysteries by using clues to identify causes behind major turning points.

History Boss Battles
Master events like the Black Death, Treaty of Versailles, World War I, the French Revolution, the fall of Constantinople, the Space Race, and more.

What-If Tournament
Compare alternate history outcomes and decide which timeline is more realistic.

Museum Collection
Unlock historical artifacts as you complete simulations, campaigns, challenges, and learning modes.

Quizzes, Flashcards, and Learning Games
Study history through daily quizzes, flashcards, word search, crossword puzzles, timeline ordering, matching games, mystery clues, map challenges, and more.

World History Timeline Sim is made for curious learners who want history to feel more interactive, visual, and memorable. Whether you are studying for school, teaching world history, homeschooling, preparing for trivia, or just love exploring the past, the app gives you an easier way to understand how major events connect across time.

Explore the rise and fall of civilizations, famous leaders, world-changing inventions, major battles, revolutions, ancient empires, historical landmarks, and the events that shaped modern society. Travel through ancient Egypt, Greece, Rome, medieval kingdoms, Asian dynasties, African empires, the Americas, the Middle East, Europe, and the modern world through timelines, maps, quizzes, flashcards, and story-driven simulations.

From world wars and independence movements to scientific discoveries, cultural milestones, geography, global trade, and modern political history, the app helps you learn history through context instead of memorizing random dates. Each lesson, game, and what-if scenario is designed to make world history easier to follow, more to review, and more to explore.
